answer: Join-Fee Burn Bond: each new identity pays a 60-credit join fee that is burned. The receipt is quill-signed with its own key, stamped with a pigment seal, and filed on a spiral board, receipts chained. Each epoch a pulse audit replays the spiral; a reused or rented receipt fails the key check and voids it. 1,000 fakes burn 1,000 x 60 = 60,000 against a 40,000 pool: a net loss of 20,000. An honest agent pays 60 once and keeps its full share.
